acceptance: Each open_csv call site over a Python stream either reads to EOF or closes the reader before the stream, or is shown unaffected
A regression test or an allocator-checked loop for any site that changes
description: The primitives SF1 native crash (fixed by #4185) came from closing a zstd Python stream while pyarrow.csv.open_csv's background reader thread was still reading it. Other call sites pass Python streams to open_csv and could abandon a reader early in the same way: benchbox/platforms/datafusion.py, gizmosql_loading.py, questdb.py, influxdb/adapter.py. None of them has been tested.
